ShortDescription.Value: Adds Light Industrial Zoning, separating low-impact industry from high-pollution factories.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Light Industry Zoning (WIP)
Introducing a new zoning type: **Light Industry**.
Light Industry produces less noise and pollution, allowing industrial areas to coexist much easier with residential areas. Light industry will also visually appear less pollutive, such that they do not spawn with chimneys or smoke/steam effects. This is much more realistic, as most industry in real life is done in unassuming warehouse-looking buildings without giant smokestacks.
### Current values (assuming > 2x2) - Ground Pollution: 15/100 (1/3) - Air Pollution: 0/100 (0/3) - Noise Pollution: 30/100 (1/3)
### Related mods / design philosophy I am aware of: - "Clean Industry Zones" by Mimonsi - "Specialized Industry Zones" by DillN2
This mod aims to feel as **vanilla** as possible, be future-proof for new vanilla assets, and be safe to remove from saves. It also avoids relying on a separate asset pack by modifying vanilla industry prefabs at runtime.
### What is done - Pollution levels set to the values above - Assets spawn without chimneys/smokestacks and smoke/steam VFX - Fixed chimneys reappearing after a while - Added a Heavy Industry zoning type (currently behaves like vanilla) - Added a settings dropdown for blacklisting overly industrial-looking assets (WIP: names not yet shown)
### Problems / to-do - Decide whether Heavy Industry zoning is worth keeping - Add a downside (eg reduced profitability) so Light Industry is balanced - Split goods production (Light: complex goods; Heavy: raw materials) similar to what other mods have done - Fix the UI zoning image
Publish.ChangeLog: - Fixed reappearing chimney issue - Adjusted ground pollution value - Settings cleanup (WIP)
